name: Node.js
body: An llms.txt for AI tools, security.txt, preloaded HSTS, and two sitemaps. But 19 of the 20 pages analyzed share one meta description, the home page's, so Learn and About pitch the same line in search.
lesson: Write a description per page that says what that page answers. A shared one tells search nothing new.
summary: nodejs.org scores 89 out of 100 (B). 0 checks fail now, 15 are at risk, and 22 pass. Fix first: other sites can frame the page.

fix.title: Other sites can frame the page
fix.evidence: Neither X-Frame-Options nor CSP frame-ancestors was sent, so the page can be framed for clickjacking. Missing on all 20 pages analyzed.
fix.fix: Send Content-Security-Policy: frame-ancestors 'self' (and X-Frame-Options: SAMEORIGIN for old browsers).

fix.title: No content security policy
fix.evidence: content-security-policy was absent on the start page. Missing on all 20 pages analyzed. Injected scripts are not limited by the browser.
fix.fix: Start with the Report-Only policy in the fix kit, watch the reports for a week, then enforce it.

fix.title: Referrer-Policy is not sent
fix.evidence: Browsers fall back to their default. An explicit policy keeps full URLs from leaking to other sites. Missing on all 20 pages analyzed.

fix.title: Permissions-Policy is not sent
fix.evidence: Embedded content can ask for the camera, microphone, or location. Missing on all 20 pages analyzed.

fix.title: No Organization or Person entity describes who is behind the site
fix.evidence: AI answers lean on this to name the brand, its logo, and its profiles. The page links 6 profiles that could go in sameAs.
fix.fix: Add Organization (or Person) JSON-LD with name, url, logo, and sameAs. The fix kit has a draft.

fix.title: 1 description is shared by more than one page
fix.evidence: "Node.js® is a free, open-source, cross-platform JavaScript runtime env…" on /en, /learn, /en/about and 16 more.
fix.fix: Describe each page on its own.
